classification: retrospective replication across developmental geometries; not untouched prospective confirmation
architecture_and_selection: exact hashed calibrated HyperSpatial-MAP runner; unchanged
anchor_rule: source-only select_non_axial_anchors implemented by the hashed runner; exact genes may differ by source
target_access: geometry, identifiers, gene names and source-selected 16 anchor columns only before prediction serialization; all non-anchor target expression evaluation-only

unsupported_requested_outputs.predictive_uncertainty: unavailable because the frozen calibrated MAP has no uncertainty head or locked uncertainty estimator
unsupported_requested_outputs.boundary_F1_Hausdorff_IoU: not part of the frozen evaluator; may be omitted rather than introduced post hoc

success_rule.residual: pooled residual Pearson positive with embryo-level hierarchical-bootstrap lower CI above zero
success_rule.reference: MAP improves over registered IDW in residual recovery, at least one localization endpoint, and without major global degradation
success_rule.replication: positive improvements at more than one stage
success_rule.component: competitive with anchor-only on residual Pearson, Dice and RMSE; balanced Pareto interpretation rather than universal endpoint victory
